description: This script is used for migrating email data from an old database schema to HTML files, handling email content extraction, directory management, and optional uploading to Amazon S3. It processes email records, generates HTML files based on templates, and updates the database with the new file paths.

classes.name: Model
classes.description: Handles database queries and data retrieval for email records.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes SQL queries with optional parameter binding.

classes.name: View
classes.description: Responsible for rendering email templates with provided variables.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches and processes a specified email template.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Provides file handling capabilities, including uploading files to cloud storage.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates file handler objects for interacting with storage services like S3.
